Hi @poojaranjan — could **ERC-1450 (ethereum/ERCs#1335, Stagnant → Draft)** be added to the **EIP Editing Office Hour #102 agenda (June 16)**? I'm one of the authors and I'll attend to walk the editors through it and answer questions.

Status: all CI checks are green and every author approval is in (including the original 2018 author), and has been since December 2025. The PR has been carried in the Draft section of the agenda since **Meeting #94** without being reached. If the editors would prefer, I'm glad to **split it into a minimal Stagnant→Draft status diff, with the content changes as Draft-stage follow-ups**.

I'd also really appreciate help with Discord access — I keep getting auto-kicked by Wick whenever I try to join to attend:

- Member: `devender_startengine` (ID `1452824086425112717`)
- Reason given: "Account Suspicious" (my account is only a few months old; I've since verified my phone number)
- Kicked on April 1, again on June 10, and again today (June 11)

I emailed support@ethereumcatherders.com on June 10 about both the Discord access and this PR, but haven't heard back yet — so I wanted to flag it here too. Happy to join the Zoom directly if that's easier. Thank you for everything you do running these office hours.
